title: Run a project's Node script with its parameters (a build stage)
description: A stage of a parametric project's build (project.params.json): runs one of the project's own Node scripts in the project folder as node <script> <params file> <out folder> <resolved spec or ->. The script reads its values from the parameters file (JSON) and writes what it makes under the out folder, mirroring the project's layout (out/parts/a.stl becomes parts/a.stl once every check of the build holds); build/derived.json there gives later stages ${derived.name}.

params.name: script
params.description: The script, relative to the project folder.

params.name: params
params.description: The parameters file (the build passes it).

params.name: out
params.description: Where to write (the build passes build/.next).

params.name: spec
params.description: The stage's template, resolved (the build passes it; - when the stage has none).
